name: OpenVibe.Billing
notes: The isolated money ledger (ADR-012): balanced append-only journal, provider receipts, subscriptions/entitlements, refunds and payouts, and a staff console (Network SSO, staff only) for payouts, review, reconciliation and the freeze. Proposed manifest: adds billing.staff.action (internal; released in contracts v0.17.0) and billing.receipt.external (internal: an EXTERNAL tip on a streamer's own PowerChat — subject provider_receipt <provider>:<payment id>; payload streamer SubjectRef, amount_cents, currency usd-cents, value_bits, donor_name (null when anonymous), anonymous, message, provider, provider_event_id, delivery_id, receipt_ref, receiving_account, app_ref, app_purpose, occurred_at, test, rates — sent only while BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing, consumed by OpenVibe.Tips) to the released 0.2.0.
